officialSendingAgency.name: Department of Foreign Employment / EPS Korea Section
officialSendingAgency.address: EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur, Nepal

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea lists Nepal's sending agency as the Department of Foreign Employment and the reception office as EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur.
EPS Korea Section Nepal is actively publishing 2026 notices for the 2025 Manufacturing selection cycle, including skill/competency, employment application and departure processing.
HRD Korea currently shows Nepal's new EPS-TOPIK schedule as unconfirmed, so this pack must not present a new 2026 Nepal recruitment window as open.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Check only against the current Nepal EPS notice and HRD Korea requirements before applying.

stages.title: Official EPS application / registration
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Use only the application channel and instructions named in the current Nepal EPS notice. Do not pay an intermediary to register you.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK fee payment
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Verify the current fee, payment channel and deadline in the official notice before paying.

stages.title: Identity / biometric requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Follow only the identity, photograph or biometric instructions stated in the current official notice.

stages.title: Application document verification
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Pre-check all documents and data against the current official Nepal notice before submission.

stages.title: Exam admission document
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Obtain and verify the official exam admission document using the current EPS Korea Section instructions.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK
stages.authority: HRD Korea
stages.action: Take the official EPS-TOPIK only on the schedule announced for Nepal.

stages.title: Skill & competency test
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Follow the official skill and competency test notice for the applicable manufacturing cohort.

stages.title: Final point-system selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Check only the official final result and cohort notice. Passing one test stage is not a job guarantee.

stages.title: Pre-job country-specific checks
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Nepal-specific pre-job medical/other requirements are still being mapped. Do not rely on Indonesia-specific psychology or MCU rules.

stages.title: Medical examination before job application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated provider
stages.action: Use only the medical examination procedure and provider named for the applicable Nepal cohort.

stages.title: Employment application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: For the verified 2025 Manufacturing cohort, a job-application notice was published in June 2026. A new 2026 recruitment-cycle rule must not be inferred from that notice.

stages.title: Job-seeker roster
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Track official roster status and keep your registered contact details current.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.authority: Korean employer / EPS
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process. No private broker can guarantee selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Review employer, pay, hours, accommodation and deductions using the official SLC process.

stages.title: Post-SLC country-specific requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Follow only the Nepal cohort notice for post-SLC medical, training or document requirements.

stages.title: Visa and departure document package
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Korean mission
stages.action: Use the current Nepal EPS departure and visa-document instructions. Exact checklist remains under country review.

stages.title: Pre-departure preparation / training
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated institution
stages.action: Complete only the official training and preparation required for the applicable Nepal cohort.

stages.title: Final health / departure readiness
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Follow the current departure-call notice for any final medical or departure readiness requirements.

stages.title: Departure to Korea
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Travel only under the official departure list and instructions for your cohort.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.authority: HRD Korea / employment training institution
stages.action: After entry, complete the official employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.authority: Employment training institution / employer
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts at official handover.

stages.title: Residence Registration
stages.authority: Korea Immigration Service
stages.action: After arrival, follow the current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: Eps Insurance Check
stages.authority: HRD Korea EPS / employer / worker
stages.action: Confirm the required EPS insurance obligations through the official EPS information.

stages.title: First Payroll Check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the contract, working hours and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor Support Ready
stages.authority: Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Keep official labor-support channels and your contract, payslips, bank deposits and attendance records ready.

stages.title: Employment Maintenance
stages.authority: MOEL employment center / EPS
stages.action: Use the official EPS or employment-center process if a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs.
